title: Wireframes are the authoritative source of truth on visual and copy questions
context: Multiple source documents exist: wireframes, PRD, FORGER-SPEC.md, FORGER-UI.md, and naming decisions. They may disagree.
decision: Establish a source hierarchy where the wireframes always win on visual, copy, and interface questions. The PRD wins over FORGER-SPEC.md and FORGER-UI.md. When every source is silent, raise the question and stop.
consequences: Clear resolution of conflicts during implementation; visual truth is always in the wireframes, not the narrative; implementation must defer to wireframes rather than interpreting the PRD prose.
